note: Micon submodule: lets editors set a Micon icon on menu links. Forces the menu_link_content link field form widget to micon_menu; also adds an icon control to the node form Menu settings and the menu-link-edit form, gated by the `use micon menu` permission. Icon is stored on the menu link's link value at options.attributes.data-icon (position at data-icon-position). hook_preprocess_menu() iconizes items at render. Global config micon_menu.config.packages limits offered packages (form /admin/structure/micon/link, permission administer micon). Requires menu_link_content, menu_ui, micon_link. Medium reads back a menu link's stored icon; hard sets a data-icon on a menu link. Grounded in real menu_link_content link options.

evals.prompt: With micon_menu, where on a menu link is the chosen Micon icon stored?
evals.expected_output: On the menu_link_content link value: link.options.attributes.data-icon (and data-icon-position for before/after/icon_only).

evals.prompt: Which permission does micon_menu add to control who can add icons to menu links?
evals.expected_output: The `use micon menu` permission ('Allow adding icons to menu items') gates the icon control on the node Menu settings and the menu-link-edit form.

evals.prompt: How does micon_menu get the icon to actually appear in a themed menu, without editing templates?
evals.expected_output: hook_preprocess_menu() iterates menu items and, where the item's Url has a data-icon option, replaces the title with MiconIconize (honoring after/icon_only) - no template override needed.

evals.prompt: This site has a menu link titled 'Micon Menu Med' (in the main menu) that was given a Micon icon via micon_menu. Inspect the live site and report the icon selector stored on that menu link.
evals.expected_output: The icon is fa-home: the menu_link_content item's link.options.attributes.data-icon = fa-home.

evals.prompt: This site has a menu link titled 'Micon Menu Task' in the main menu with no icon. Using micon_menu's storage convention, set its Micon icon to fa-star and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The 'Micon Menu Task' menu_link_content item's link.options.attributes.data-icon = fa-star.
